_comment: Time-boxed exceptions for the dependency audit gate (scripts/audit-gate.mjs).
Every entry MUST have: package, reason, owner, expires (ISO date, max 30 days out).
An expired entry fails CI on purpose — exceptions cannot become permanent.
Do not add entries to silence a finding you have not triaged.

exceptions.reason: 23 packages depend on vitest@1.6.1; upgrading to 3.2.6 requires coordinated migration. Tracked in v1.3 roadmap.
